name: Statement of Work from the primary quote (Opportunity)
summary: Statement of Work from an Opportunity: the primary CPQ quote with its terms and a table of its quote lines (two levels of related lists: Opportunity → Quotes → Quote Lines, each line reading its Product), the customer's contact roles, and a multi-year clause per quote.
description: Fontara Statement of Work from an Opportunity, its primary quote and the quote's lines. Built from assets/salesforce-gen-templates/specs/sow-quote-opportunity.json.

body.p: This Statement of Work is issued by **{{Account.Fontara_Entity__c}}** ("Fontara") to **{{Account.Name}}** ("Customer") under the Master Subscription Agreement between them. It describes the subscription Fontara will deliver and how the parties will run the rollout.

then.p: **Multi-year delivery.** The quantities above are committed for every year of the {{SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c}}-month term. Fontara invoices each subscription year in advance, and the rollout plan below covers the first year; the parties review adoption at each anniversary.

else.p: **Annual delivery.** The quantities above apply for twelve months; any change at renewal is made by a new quote.

bullets: **Kickoff** within ten business days of the subscription start date: Fontara assigns a named onboarding manager and agrees the rollout calendar with Customer's lead.
**Configuration** in the first 30 days: single sign-on, user provisioning and the reporting workspace.
**Phased rollout**: users go live by site in waves agreed at kickoff; Fontara runs a training session for each wave.
**Adoption review** 90 days after the start date, with usage against the quantities above.

body.p: Each phase is accepted when Customer's lead confirms it in writing or does not raise a defect within ten business days of Fontara's completion notice.
